name: Bangsaen42 (Bangsaen Marathon)
short_description: Bangsaen42 is a full-marathon event at Bang Saen Beach, Chonburi, Thailand, scheduled for November 15, 2026.
ai_summary: Bangsaen42 (Bangsaen Marathon) is a full-marathon event scheduled for November 15, 2026, held at Bang Saen Beach in Bang Saen, Chonburi, Thailand. The race offers three distance options: a full marathon of 42.195 km, a half marathon of 21.1 km, and a 10 km race.
pros: Marathon only, on roads fully closed to traffic
Certified course with a World Athletics Elite Label
Water about every 2 km and a seven-hour limit from the last wave
Big field (9,729 finishers in 2025) with King Kong awards for the first 100 men and women
cons: Very humid before dawn: 27°C and 94% humidity at the 2025 start
Five intermediate cut-offs enforced on the clock
Wave starts at 2.30am to 3am, with the start line closing at 3.10am
Late climb at Khao Sam Muk after the coastal out-and-back

faqs.question: When is Bangsaen42 (Bangsaen Marathon) taking place?
faqs.answer: Bangsaen42, also known as the Bangsaen Marathon, is scheduled to take place on November 15, 2026. The race will be held at Bang Saen Beach, located in Bang Saen, Chonburi, Thailand, giving runners a coastal setting for the event.

faqs.question: What distances can I run at Bangsaen42?
faqs.answer: Bangsaen42 offers three distance options for participants to choose from: a full marathon of 42.195 km, a half marathon of 21.1 km, and a shorter 10 km race. The primary distance for this event is the full 42.195 km marathon.
